text: US stocks slipped Friday, led by a second straight drop in tech. The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,562, the Nasdaq fell 0.9% and the Dow edged up 0.1%. Nvidia fell again after its CEO resigned, and Treasury yields rose. Most sectors outside tech finished higher, and the S&P 500 still gained 2.5% on the week, its first winning week since early October. The TSX was steadier, closing at 36,106, down 0.1%.
mood: Cautious, not panicked: the worry is concentrated in AI and tech, and the rest of the market held up.

veqt.t: The main drag today. Tech-led losses in the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, but the Dow rose and the week was still up 2.5%.
Barely moved. The TSX closed down 0.1% at 36,106.
European markets were mixed on the day. I could not verify Japan or the rest of Asia.
No reliable close found for today, so no read.
